text:
harry.partners: Quick sync: need a distilled handoff for Gaudi + MI300 + H200 wave. Ask: one canonical mapping for marketplace tile, SI installer, embargo matrix, and fallback routing. Keep it short for legal and ops.

ivy-hw: Ill own HW validation artifacts: signed firmware hash, RC kernel-tag, bench-power.csv. Vendor PS: Habana may ship a microcode RC that could change freeze by ~72h.

jules-prod: Marketplace wants tile JSON, pricing slug, a customer-facing fallback blurb, and the embargo matrix (exact start/end). Also add a "canary cohort" flag for early customers.

sam.devex: Devex will provide quickstart + SI installer tarball + CI smoke. Example smoke command to standardize: `./smoke --model llama2-13b --seq 1024 --bs 1 --target_p50 140`. Will add an example `canary/` folder.

lee-oncall: Ops: propose routing policy pseudo: `if cap(mi300_region)<0.18 => prefer [h200_fallback,b200_fallback] else if p50_delta>0.25 => prefer gaudi_compat_degraded`. Need explicit SLO notes in tile for canary vs GA customers.

harry.partners: Owners: Ivy->HW artifacts + vendor intros; Jules->marketplace tile + embargo matrix; Sam->devex + CI; Lee->ops playbook; Harry->press + handoff doc. Draft single-sheet mapping by Wed EOD; cert artifacts final by Fri EOD.

ivy-hw: Vendor contacts: nvidia:maria@nvidia, habana:raj@habana, amd:lucas@amd. Ill DM intros and post confirmation. If microcode lands late, we push embargo by 72h.

jules-prod: Marketplace tile snippet I'll add to the sheet. Example fallback blurb: "If MI300 capacity is constrained, workloads may route to H200/B200 where available; expect ~10-35% latency variance." Will include canary flag and blackout dates.

sam.devex: Creating CI job `ci/marketplace/gaudi-mi300/smoke` and quickstart PR. Canary tests will fail the job if p50 > 200ms for 10m.

lee-oncall: INFRA action: request lab-image tagged `power-profile-gaudi-v2` for thermal repro. Filing INFRA-6123.

harry.partners: Recap action items in sheet "HW-Onramp-Mapping":
- Ivy: vendor intros + firmware freeze dates
- Jules: marketplace tile + embargo matrix
- Sam: quickstart + CI templates
- Lee: ops routing playbook + infra ticket
- Harry: press comms + canary schedule

harry.partners: Scheduling 15m sync Thu 10:00 to walk the sheet and confirm blackout + canary windows. If anyone needs extra time because of vendor shifts, flag here. :calendar: :thumbsup:
